name: Fayette County, PA
findings: Fayette County has 338 nonprofit organizations. 143 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 115 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Fayette County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Fayette County list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 69% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 120 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 24 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Fayette County list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Few education organizations list membership
observations.text: 2 education organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 7 would.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through education groups? Where else does that happen?
